description: Karnataka's CM D K Shivakumar launched KEO, an AI-ready computing platform aimed at democratizing access to technology in schools, businesses, and communities, with 1,000 devices initially deployed. KEO combines open-source architecture and on-device AI to enhance learning opportunities across the state.
body_lead: Karnataka Chief Minister D K Shivakumar on Friday launched KEO, a compact, AI-ready computing platform designed to democratise access to advanced computing and bring the power of artificial intelligence to homes, classrooms, businesses and communities across the country. It has been developed through a collaboration between the Department of Electronics, IT and Biotechnology, Government of Karnataka, KEONICS, semiconductor partners and AI-focused system integrators, officials said.
